decision: Cleared for the bounded MD-2 consolidation delta. No new actionable correctness, compatibility, ownership, error-handling, concurrency or unsafe-code finding in the two changed implementation files. This is not application parity or full library acceptance.

source_evidence.conclusion: Canonical state now implements Copy and owns split, drawer_open and return_focus. Public facade state name reexports this type; existing constructor/default/Copy/drawer_open use remains available. No public fields removed.

Single responsive mode and summary-row resolver. Controls layout adds SplitPane geometry; draw consumes the same complete controls layout. The new method explicitly documents empty split rectangles; callers requiring complete geometry must use layout.
Facade open/close delegate canonical state lifecycle and retain configured master focus restoration. Existing typed actions and already-open/already-closed responses preserved.

Facade scoped Escape retains child-first routing and uses the shared resolver against framework logical-area facts. Controls owner bindings remain a separate intentional input policy; no facade adoption of controls Tab/Left/BackTab behavior.

Measure/show use the shared responsive decision and summary clamp. Group/CompositionSlots remain content composition owners; fixed-share and resizable adapters both delegate actual split geometry to SplitPane. No input/domain effects added to measure/draw.
